usedFor: Signing events in Yousign, such as “Signature Request Approved”, create booking links in Calendly through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Signature Request Approved” in Yousign, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Once a signature request is approved, the action creates a booking link, so a kickoff call can follow the signing.

watchOut: “Update Workspace” in Yousign polls, so a link made from it arrives on a schedule.
